[1] After playing their first two home games at Yankee Stadium, the New York Giants played the rest of their home games at the Yale Bowl.

[3] As of the 2010 United States Census, the borough's population was 8,913, reflecting an increase of 197 (+2.3%) from the 8,716 counted in the 2000 Census, which had in turn increased by 814 (+10.3%) from the 7,902 counted in the 1990 Census.
